registered: 2026-08-18, BEFORE the MRP baseline is written or run
why: Earth-1's calibration is a hand-rolled unregularized MRP step 1. The mature method (MrsP/autoMrP) is the field standard for small-area estimation and must be beaten, or adopted, on identical terms.
input_budget_parity: MRP gets EXACTLY what Earth-1's calibration gets: the same 40 questions' country targets on TRAIN folds only, plus census/context marginals. It does NOT get individual WVS respondents — using them would be data Earth-1 never sees and a win would mean nothing.
fairness: autoMrP-style: context-level covariates selected and regularized by cross-validation, NOT hand-picked, since the published finding is that ML selection beats expert choice. A weak hand-built MRP that loses proves nothing.
protocol: same pinned CV folds (data/cv_folds.json), same corrected truth (goqa_ground_truth.json), same LOO-country holdout, poststratified over the engine's own demographic cells.

PRE-REGISTERED READING OF BOTH OUTCOMES.if_MRP_wins: UPGRADE, not defeat — adopt mature machinery (MrsP genesis-from-marginals, EMRP uncertainty propagation, autoMrP selection) and redirect original research to the event-response operator, which the field does not have.
PRE-REGISTERED READING OF BOTH OUTCOMES.if_EARTH1_wins: strongest claim available: beats the gold-standard small-area method in its own domain on identical inputs — verifiable by any quant in an afternoon.
PRE-REGISTERED READING OF BOTH OUTCOMES.if_tie: Earth-1's cross-sectional layer is methodologically equivalent to the standard; the differentiator must be dynamics, and the pitch says so.
